seo.title: Our Fleet | Kasi Transport
seo.description: The trucks and vehicles Kasi Transport uses, explained in plain language: small trucks, pallet trucks, container movers, cranes, towing and refrigerated vehicles, across Peninsular Malaysia.

intro.title: The right vehicle for every load.
intro.text: From a small truck for urgent parcels to a prime mover for shipping containers, here is what we can send, and what each one is best for.

helper.title: What are you moving?
helper.text: Pick the closest match and we will show the vehicles that usually suit.
helper.empty: Choose what you are moving to see our suggestions.

network.title: Our own trucks, plus trusted partners.
network.text: Some jobs are done by our own trucks and drivers. For others, we work with independent transport partners, so we can find the right vehicle when you need it.

cards.title: Our own trucks
cards.text: Company-operated vehicles with employed drivers, planned and coordinated by our operations team.

cards.title: Partner trucks
cards.text: Vehicles owned by independent drivers and transport companies in our network, used to add capacity where it is needed.

tell.title: What to tell us.
tell.text: You do not need to know which vehicle you need. Just tell us these four things and we will suggest one.

items.title: What you are moving
items.text: For example boxes, pallets, a machine or equipment.

items.title: How much
items.text: The rough size or weight, and how many items.

items.title: When
items.text: The date and time it needs to arrive.

glance.title: Every vehicle we have.
